Warum ist eine Platinenreparatur oft 70: Why is a board repair often 70% cheaper than at the manufacturer?
Hersteller wie Apple, Sony oder Vertrags: Manufacturers like Apple, Sony or authorised service centres almost never replace individual components. They declare a total loss or charge for replacing the entire mainboard (often €300 to €700). With a microscope and thermal camera we locate the single faulty SMD component (e.g. a €2 blocking capacitor or a USB-C port) and only solder in a new one. That saves real money and keeps your original data.
Gerät ins Wasser gefallen: Warum hilft R: Device fell into water: why rice does NOT help and even does harm
Reis entzieht zwar langsam oberflächlich: Rice slowly absorbs surface moisture, but it speeds up electrochemical corrosion inside. As long as the battery is connected, leakage currents eat away traces and solder pads within hours. Rice dust also settles under BGA chips. Immediate action: cut the power right away (don't switch it on, don't plug it in) and bring it to our workshop for chemical isopropanol ultrasonic cleaning as quickly as possible.
Was ist der Vorteil von Hall-Effect Anal: What is the advantage of Hall effect analog sticks in controllers?
Herkömmliche Controller (PS5 DualSense,: Standard controllers (PS5 DualSense, Xbox, Switch Joy-Con) use mechanical carbon-track potentiometers with sliding contacts. After a few months the material wears down – causing the notorious "stick drift". Our Hall effect sensors measure the position contact-free via magnetic fields (permanent magnets & semiconductor sensors). Since nothing rubs mechanically, the stick is practically indestructible and drift-free.
Was bedeutet »No Data – No Fee« bei der: What does "No data – no fee" mean for emergency data recovery?
Wenn dein Smartphone, Laptop oder Speich: If your smartphone, laptop or storage is dead after a bad fall or liquid damage, we do everything we can to make the board bootable again temporarily and read out your photos, videos, WhatsApp chats and documents. If the internal memory chips are physically destroyed beyond recovery and no data can be saved, you pay €0 for the data recovery.
